claim_scores.rationale: Shows `before(x="sky?")` succeeds with `dspy.settings.lm is lm` while `before.p.lm is None`, then `opt.compile(before, trainset=trainset)` is caught as `ValueError` and asserts both required substrings.
Defines one `metric` and one `trainset` once, and reuses the same `opt`/`trainset` setup for both compile attempts; only LM attachment changes between attempts.
Uses `after.set_lm(lm)` before the second compile and explicitly proves the predictor-local LM changes from `None` to the same `DummyLM` instance via assertions.
Constructs `DummyLM({"sky?": {"y": "blue"}})`, i.e. dictionary mode keyed by input text, and comments that it is repeatable for multiple offline calls.
Patches `finetune_lms` to return `{(lm, None): lm}`, checks `mocked.assert_called_once()`, then asserts the compiled module is `after`, has `_compiled is True`, and `compiled.p.lm is lm`.
